comparison.objective: Open a folding fan fully and leave it released on its stand.
comparison.physical_skill: Counterhold one guard stick while sweeping the other around a stiff rivet.
comparison.success_condition: Fan spread at least 135 degrees, supported and released; full credit also requires arm withdrawal.
comparison.reason: Although it uses counterholding and controlled rotation, it lacks tool alignment, fastener release/relock, bounded tightening, and adjustment from repeated impact response.
